name: Dere Academy
source:
You basically went into an Academy called "Chatousen". You meet these girls when you woke up from your class which is before the last one. You can do free time events with the cast.

[Edited from [url=https://tiedwalkgames.itch.io/dere-academy-vn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你基本上进入了一个名为“Chatousen”的学院。当你从最后一节课之前的课上醒来时，你会遇到这些女孩。你可以与演员一起参加空闲时间活动。

[编辑自[url=https://tiedwalkgames.itch.io/dere-academy-vn]itch.io[/url]]
